about: The plants' numbers for the props (w9-village-physics 2.8; D-089): stems per drawn grass instance per prefab and per layer of maps/farmland/map.json, and each vendor tree and bush variant's drawn leaf area per m3 of its twig shell. Measured from the local store by python tools/blender/vendor_plant_numbers.py; method and limits in openspec/changes/w9-village-physics/design.md 2.8. Widths in mm as drawn where a blade crosses a horizontal plane (p10, p50, p90).
